purpose: Motion-refresh variant: refresh color contour ownership on motion but reuse cached stereo rough distance on refresh frames to avoid synchronous matchTemplate spikes.
expected_effect: Update color contour masks when slow-pan motion is detected.
Avoid heavy stereo rematching on motion/interval refresh frames after the startup cache exists.
Preserve rough far-distance evidence by transferring cached stereo estimates to matching refreshed contours.
risk: Transferred stereo distance can become stale during large viewpoint changes.
Needs a later split-frame or asynchronous stereo refresh path for high-confidence live-motion distance updates.
